## authoring

🛠️ Creating skills, custom agents, commands and prompt files, instructions and rules, hooks, plugins and orchestration packs for GitHub Copilot, Claude Code and OpenAI Codex, plus auditing a whole collection. Each covers this repository's single-source format and your own project's native files. Install the whole plugin with `authoring@jaktestowac`.

| Skill | What it does | Extras |
| --- | --- | :---: |
| [`creating-skills`](../src/skills/creating-skills/SKILL.md) | Creates agent skills (a `SKILL.md` folder plus optional resources) that load in GitHub Copilot, Claude Code and OpenAI Codex: a description that triggers on the right requests, a lean body with progressive disclosure, checkable steps, and a validation pass. | [📎](../src/skills/creating-skills/resources/ "Browse resources") |
| [`creating-custom-agents`](../src/skills/creating-custom-agents/SKILL.md) | Creates custom agents (subagents): a focused role with its own instructions, the fewest tools the job needs, explicit boundaries, stop conditions and an output contract, written as a Copilot `.agent.md`, a Claude Code agent file, a Codex agent TOML, or this collection's single-source agent format. | [📎](../src/skills/creating-custom-agents/resources/ "Browse resources") |
| [`creating-prompts`](../src/skills/creating-prompts/SKILL.md) | Creates reusable commands the user starts on purpose (`/name`, or `$name` in Codex): one job, declared inputs with hints, ask-when-missing behaviour, a concrete output and location, a verification step and guardrails. | [📎](../src/skills/creating-prompts/resources/ "Browse resources") |
| [`creating-instructions`](../src/skills/creating-instructions/SKILL.md) | Creates instruction files and scoped rules that agents apply automatically: repository-wide guidance (`copilot-instructions.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `AGENTS.md`) and file-scoped rules (Copilot `.instructions.md` with `applyTo`, Claude Code `.claude/rules/` with `paths`, Codex `AGENTS.md`), plus rules in this collection's single-source format. | [📎](../src/skills/creating-instructions/resources/ "Browse resources") |
| [`creating-hooks`](../src/skills/creating-hooks/SKILL.md) | Creates lifecycle hooks: small scripts the host runs at session start, before or after a tool call, on prompt submit or at stop, to log, add context, warn or block deterministically. | [📎](../src/skills/creating-hooks/resources/ "Browse resources") |
| [`creating-plugins`](../src/skills/creating-plugins/SKILL.md) | Packages skills, commands, agents, hooks and MCP servers as installable plugins with a marketplace for GitHub Copilot, Claude Code and OpenAI Codex: choosing what to bundle, writing each host's manifest and marketplace entry, and checking the result installs. | [📎](../src/skills/creating-plugins/resources/ "Browse resources") |
